ghi_chu: Chan moi-chuoi sinh dan so bang cach lay MOI chuoi trong lat roi TRU theo luat co ten. HAI danh sach TACH BIET, va tach la co ly do: mot thuoc tinh JSX ten `name` la ky thuat, nhung mot KHOA object ten `name` thuong la nhan hien len man ({ name: "Ninety days after close" }). Dung chung mot danh sach cho ca hai chinh la cho lop loi nay chui qua.

khoa_kieu.ghi_chu: Khoa cua kieu chi muc vao kho chuoi — gia tri la TEN KHOA, khong phai chu nguoi doc. Khai o day thay vi mien tru tung gia tri, vi danh sach gia tri se dai theo so muc thanh ben.

khoa_object_mang_chu.ghi_chu: Khoa object KHONG duoc dua vao danh sach ky thuat, du chung cung ten voi mot thuoc tinh JSX ky thuat. Gia tri cua chung la chu nguoi doc thay.
